title: Gender Queer: A Memoir
author: Maia Kobabe
current_text: A Virginia court ordered Barnes and Noble and Virginia Beach Public Schools not to publish, sell, rent, lend or exhibit Gender Queer: A Memoir to minors. Fairfax County Public Schools temporarily removed Gender Queer: A Memoir after complaints that it contained sexually explicit language and scenes inappropriate for a juvenile audience, then decided to return it to its high school libraries after a review. Keller ISD officials said administrators removed Gender Queer: A Memoir from a high school library “out of an abundance of caution,” pending an investigation into how it had been selected and made available to students. State Rep. Jeff Cason asked Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton to investigate Gender Queer: A Memoir and other books that might violate laws concerning pornography, child pornography and decency.

sources.quote: ORDERED that pursuant to 18.2-384(5) and 18.2-384(11) of the Code of Virginia that Barnes and Noble and Virginia Beach Public Schools are hereby restrained from publishing, selling, renting, lending or exhibiting the book the book Gender Queer, A Memoir to minors.
Fairfax County Public Schools temporarily removed the books “Gender Queer: A Memoir” and “Lawn Boy” after complaints.
